interpretation.clean_noisy_top_iou: IoU between clean and noisy top masks
interpretation.clean_top_noise_region_mean: top-mask coverage inside the future noise patch before noise injection; random baseline is top_fraction
interpretation.noisy_excess_noise_region_mean: normalized excess-detail energy inside the injected noise patch
interpretation.noisy_prediction_noise_region_mean: soft prediction mean inside the injected noise patch
interpretation.noisy_prediction_outside_mean: soft prediction mean outside the injected noise patch
interpretation.noisy_target_noise_region_mean: GT-supervised missing-detail target inside the injected noise patch; should remain low if noise is excess detail
interpretation.noisy_top_noise_region_mean: top-mask coverage inside the injected noise patch after noise injection; much above top_fraction means the mask reacts to noise
